description: This file defines the ConduitContext class, a DbContext for Entity Framework Core, representing the database context for the application. It configures entity relationships, primary keys, and transaction handling logic.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: The Entity Framework DbContext subclass managing database entities and their relationships, with transaction control methods.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active, avoiding nested transactions.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, with error handling to rollback if commit fails.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction if active and releases resources.
